**Management Summary (118 words)**  

The €970 k LV shows critical gaps that jeopardize cost control and contractual compliance. High‑impact issues total €184 k: inconsistent material description (€55 k), contract‑penalty clause for delayed hydraulic‑excavator use (€48 k), mismatched LV totals and sub‑area sum (both €18.8 k), missing technical data for the branch shaft (€7.3 k) and pipe‑length description (€4 k), and a short‑text omission for the shaft (€3.3 k). Low‑value anomalies (≈€150 k) reveal systematic under‑pricing, with unit rates far below reference ranges, indicating bidders’ quantity over‑estimates. Immediate actions: (1) rectify description and material references; (2) renegotiate or clarify penalty clauses; (3) reconcile all summed totals; (4) request complete technical specifications for missing items; (5) review and adjust unit prices to realistic market levels to avoid future claims.
